title: SkillsCatalog
description: supabase/functions/skills-catalog/index.ts. PUBLIC (deployed --no-verify-jwt) — only ever returns already-approved, public rows from community_skills, so no auth is needed by design. GET with an optional ?q= query param (case-insensitive substring match against name OR tagline). Returns up to 200 rows ordered by downloads desc.

CommunitySkillRow.title: CommunitySkillRow
CommunitySkillRow.description: A single community_skills row as exposed by this endpoint (status/author_id/moderation_reason are deliberately NOT selected here — those are internal-only fields visible to the author via a different query path, not this public catalog read).

body.description: The literal text injected into Claude's system prompt when this skill is activated. Stored in-row (no storage bucket).
